chunks.text: Let's see, I rank these in order based on my personal beliefs and values that I have.
As a Christian, it was easy to choose religious utopia as the first choice.
And then beyond that, I'm generally a little distrusting in AI and advancing too quickly with science and technology.
So I leaned towards putting AI at the bottom and other similar societies more towards the bottom.
And then for my top societies, I leaned towards ones that seemed more traditional and conservative.
